abstract: A 42-year-old woman was admitted to our hospital with hemosputum and an abnormal shadow on chest X-ray. Although her hemosputum disappeared after the treatment of pneumonia, the abnormal shadow was not improved. Chest CT showed a mediastinal mass. She underwent thoracotomy and the tumor, measuring 6 x 5 x 5 cm in size, was resected. Pathological diagnosis was a mature type teratoma with direct invasion to the lung. We have to take mediastinal teratoma into consideration as one of the causes of pneumonia.
abstract_ja: 42歳女性が喀血と胸部X線での異常陰影のため当院に入院した。肺炎の治療後に喀血は消失したが、異常陰影は改善しなかった。胸部CTで縦隔腫瘤を認めた。開胸術を施行し、6×5×5cmの腫瘍を切除した。病理診断は成熟型奇形腫で、肺への直接浸潤を伴っていた。肺炎の原因の一つとして縦隔奇形腫を考慮すべきである。
